name: Reading Room

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can visit the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep. Civic and scholarly exchanges help sustain the city's intellectual life.

faq.answer: Roy's Book Club trades older books for modern tomes from the Stormwind library. You carry a wrapped bundle of less popular works to the library for the exchange.
faq.q: What is the Reading Room quest?

faq.answer: Roy runs a reading club where members discuss legends and literature. He arranges with the Stormwind library to rotate reading material and returns borrowed books in pristine condition.
The books go to the library in Stormwind. The librarian recognizes Roy's club's distinctive wrapping and accepts the books in exchange for modern writing.
faq.q: Where are the books being taken?

faq.answer: The club trades less popular books for more modern and thought-provoking works through its borrowing arrangement with the city library.
faq.q: Why are the books being exchanged?

faq.answer: The Stormwind librarian is pleased with the arrangement. Roy's club returns loaned books in excellent condition and treats every text with care, even when its subject is provocative.
faq.q: How does the Stormwind librarian view the book club?

faq.answer: The club offers free refreshments to patrons and helpers who assist with book exchanges between the reading venue and the city archives.
faq.q: What are the club refreshments mentioned?

sections.body: Roy's Book Club gathers readers in Stormwind to discuss classical legends and provocative writings. To keep those talks fresh, members rotate their reading. They trade older or less popular works for newer volumes from the city's library.
sections.title: Literary Pursuits in Stormwind

sections.body: Roy's Book Club keeps an established lending arrangement with the Stormwind library. Roy wraps the club's returned books in a distinctive way, and you carry them to the librarian. In return, the club receives a new list of modern tomes.
sections.title: The Library Exchange

summary: At Roy's Book Club, members trade older literature for newer works from the Stormwind library. Wrapped books carry the exchange between the club and the librarian.
